# Jami route map

Jami is an authenticated study workspace for GCSE, A-level and university
students. Start at / and sign in with Google or email. Dashboard pages load the
signed-in user's own Firebase data; a signed-out visitor cannot reach seeded or
public dashboard data.

Primary destinations:
- /dashboard - Today: the next step, or today's activities from a revision plan
- /dashboard/study - Learn: flashcard review
- /dashboard/practice - Practice: folders, notebooks, past-paper questions and generated papers
- /dashboard/tutor - Jami, the tutor
- /dashboard/decks - Flashcard decks
- /dashboard/cards - All flashcards
- /dashboard/topics - Concepts and subtopics linking material across folders
- /dashboard/goals - Goals: flashcard, practice-question and topic targets, paced, each earning a star
- /dashboard/constellation - Stars and constellation rewards
- /dashboard/progress - Progress and weak areas
- /dashboard/profile - Account and settings

Additional routes:
- /dashboard/library - Sources the tutor can read
- /dashboard/folders/[folderId] - A folder's notebooks, practice, decks and sources
- /dashboard/notebooks/[notebookId] - Page-based notebook editor
- /dashboard/practice/questions/new - Start a past-paper question session
- /dashboard/practice/new - Generate a practice paper
- /dashboard/practice/history - Practice history
- /dashboard/revision/start - Start a Revision Session
- /dashboard/tutor/plan - Revision planner: your timetable of study activities, with Jami beside it
- /dashboard/tutor/personalise - Personalise the tutor, including its memory
- /dashboard/decks/[id] - Deck detail and card management
- /dashboard/decks/[id]/study - Deck study session
- /dashboard/topics/[topicId] - Topic detail

Compatibility:
- /dashboard/practise permanently redirects to /dashboard/practice
- /dashboard/learn redirects to /dashboard/study
- /dashboard/stats redirects to /dashboard/progress

Data and privacy:
- Persistent dashboard actions require Firebase authentication.
- Notebook PDF rendering and page counting happen client-side; uploaded files
  are never modified.
- When a student adds or changes a source, Jami builds a private search index
  of it. The tutor reads matching passages only after the student asks.
- Before a harder answer the tutor may look things up and check its work in a
  few visible steps (the student's material, their earlier chats, the web,
  an independent working), inside that one request. Anything it would change
  is a proposal the student confirms.
- AI marking and help run only when the student asks.
- Do not infer always-on screen watching, browser monitoring, or a public demo
  workspace.
